_comment: FROZEN evaluation surface - reviewer-only, NEVER model-visible, and NO LONGER BAKED INTO THE IMAGE: it is uploaded fresh under /tests at scoring. The ONE exception is baseline_inventory.tsv.gz, which is image-specific, is a 1.1 MB binary the runner cannot argv-inline, and carries no answer (only inode/size/path of the image's own files) - it is baked at /opt/verifier/baseline_inventory.tsv.gz and regenerated by every rebuild. compute_reward.py reads thresholds from here. Every value is MEASURED on NVIDIA H20.
reward_formula: reward = min(1.0, ln(gain_ratio/ref_speedup)/ln(ref_speedup)) if gain_ratio > ref_speedup else 0.0, bounded to [0,1], where gain_ratio = (base_ce - candidate_ce) / (base_ce - strong_baseline_ce) on the hidden held-out split and base_ce is MEASURED LIVE on the frozen base model in the same verifier pass. gain_ratio <= 1 (tying the strong reference) => 0; gain_ratio == ref_speedup (the MEASURED in-budget ceiling) => 0.5; gain_ratio >= ref_speedup**2 => 1.0. ref_speedup and strong_baseline_ce are FROZEN CONSTANTS - the scorer NEVER runs the oracle. Any of the six reward.md 前置门 => 0 with a NAMED reason.
lever: ADAPTER BYTES (A8 参数高效微调 PEFT). A HARD cap on the total size of the ONLY two files that travel from the solver's fine-tune into the scored eval (adapter.bin + adapter_entry.py), re-measured by the harness with stat(). The harness loads the FROZEN base weights itself from a digest-checked copy and quarantines every solver-writable path for the eval window, so the cap is an information-theoretic bound on how much adaptation can reach the eval. The solver maximizes held-out quality under that cap. Rank-1 bf16 LoRA on q/v is the model-visible FLOOR; an int8-quantized, importance-allocated, tuned LoRA at the full budget is the STRONG baseline (1.0 anchor); sub-8-bit adapter quantization (QLoRA/LoftQ-family), shared or seeded random bases (VeRA), DoRA magnitude/direction decomposition, norm-and-bias tuning, adaptive rank redistribution (AdaLoRA), tensor-train factorization (DuQTTA) and a leaner container are the un-capped CEILING — all under the SAME measured byte cap.

budget_definition_G2.rule: budget := os.stat('/app/submission/adapter.bin').st_size + os.stat('/app/submission/adapter_entry.py').st_size <= max_total_bytes, with per-file caps max_artifact_bytes / max_entry_bytes. Both files are COPIED into a fresh staging dir and re-measured there; a self-reported size is never read.
budget_definition_G2.code_counts: the entry module's own bytes count, so weights smuggled into the .py as literals consume the same budget.
budget_definition_G2.quarantine: for the eval window the verifier renames /app/submission, /app/repo and the visible corpus dir out of the way (os.rename on the same overlay fs) and restores them afterwards, so build_adapted_model can read ONLY the two staged files, the digest-checked frozen base model, and root-owned site-packages (+ /opt/peft_ro/src). This closes both the side-file channel and the 'fine-tune inside the load hook' evasion (no training data is reachable), and a 90 s SIGALRM cap closes a long data-free search.
budget_definition_G2.base_weights_frozen: sha256(/app/base_model/model.safetensors) is verified against base_model_sha256 — the harness owns the weights, so nothing can be pre-baked into them.
budget_definition_G2.why_unhackable: the scored CE is produced by the module the harness itself built from (frozen base + <=320 KiB of solver bytes); the anti-spoof kit forces that module to be a real LM (position-dependent logits, real-text CE << arbitrary-ids CE, plausible CE band, >=300M params), so the bytes the harness counted ARE the only adaptation that could have produced the score.
budget_definition_G2.whole_filesystem_stash_sweep: MANDATORY (2026-07-26 corpus-wide budget-cap directive). Before the eval the harness sweeps EVERY writable mount from /proc/mounts INCLUDING every tmpfs (/dev/shm, /tmp, /var/tmp), deduped by (dev, inode) so a hardlink farm is counted once, and diffs each file against a baked inventory of the PRISTINE image (/tests/baseline_inventory.tsv.gz, root-0700). Every solver-created or modified file is either QUARANTINED (any data-ish extension, any symlink, or > 32 KiB) or, if it is a small readable source file, its bytes are CHARGED to the SAME total budget as the declared files. If the inventory is missing the verifier FAILS CLOSED - an unenforceable cap never scores.
budget_definition_G2.no_side_channel: the staged load hook is rejected if its source reaches for a side channel (socket, /dev/shm, /proc/, ptrace, multiprocessing.connection, http/urllib/requests) - a surviving daemon must not be able to serve bytes a file sweep cannot see. The verifier also records its own peak RSS.
budget_definition_G2.stash_oracle: a frozen STASH-ORACLE control (/opt/stash_oracle) ships a tiny artifact and tries to load its real adaptation from an extra directory, /dev/shm, /tmp and a hardlink - it MUST score 0. Shipped in the negative set as VERIFIER_MODE=negative_stash.
budget_definition_G2.sweep_fairness: Solver scratch is QUARANTINED, not charged: charging small files would penalise an honest solver whose training left .pyc/.log/cache files behind. Only files the harness cannot move are charged. The allowlist (.pyc/.log/.txt/.json <= 32 KiB, never a symlink) cannot carry an importable payload once its source is quarantined.
budget_definition_G2.sweep_semantics: Symlinks are SKIPPED (they carry no bytes and their target is swept independently, so a link into a stash dangles once the stash moves) - an earlier revision quarantined /usr/bin/python3 because a find -type f inventory never lists symlinks. System paths (/etc /var /usr /lib /bin /sbin) churn at container start and are CHARGED to the budget rather than moved, except that a data-extension file there is still quarantined. Everything solver-created in a working area (/app /tmp /dev/shm /root /home /scratch /opt/<new>) is quarantined regardless of size.
budget_definition_G2.sweep_residual: MEASURED residual, documented not hidden: the container runtime injects ~624 MB of CUDA driver libraries into /usr at start, so no image inventory can list them; system prefixes are therefore IGNORED by the charge (a data-extension file there is still quarantined). A determined cheater could hide bytes in a NON-data-extension file under /usr or /var. Closing step: regenerate the baseline inventory from a GPU-attached first boot (so the injected libraries are in it) and then charge system prefixes too; or add a driver-library allowlist. The primary routes (working-area stash, declared bytes, IPC side channel) are all MEASURED closed: the stash-oracle scores 0.0.
budget_definition_G2.sweep_quarantine_placement: one quarantine directory PER MOUNT so the move is always same-device: an EXDEV os.rename failure (tmpfs vs the overlay) used to be charged to the budget and failed the honest path (MEASURED 161 MB). shutil.move is the fallback; only a truly immovable file is charged.
budget_definition_G2.sweep_regular_files_only: MEASURED FIX: the sweep now skips every non-regular file (stat.S_ISREG). Before this, it treated character devices as solver-created files and tried to quarantine them; the shutil.move fallback COPIED an infinite device (/dev/urandom, /dev/zero) into a quarantine dir on a tmpfs, i.e. into RAM. Measured consequence: the verifier was OOM-killed (rc=137, cgroup oom_kill=2) at the declared 48 GiB memory_mb, and at a 128 GiB limit it sat blocked in the kernel's _random_read for 27+ minutes with VmPeak 232 GB. THIS IS WHY NO HONEST PATH HAD EVER COMPLETED ON IMAGE :v3. The fix does not weaken the cap: a stash must be a regular file, hardlinks ARE regular files and stay deduped by (dev, inode), symlinks were already skipped, and the stash-oracle's /dev/shm/stash.bin is a regular file and is still detected. compute_reward_sha256 re-pinned bd2160ad9a14... -> ffd0d7b232d1...
budget_definition_G2.sweep_readonly_bind_mounts: MEASURED ROOT CAUSE + FIX. The container runtime bind-mounts NVIDIA driver assets over individual image paths: gsp_ga10x.bin (74,942,448 B), nvoptix.bin (60,858,204 B), gsp_tu10x.bin (30,438,488 B) = 166,239,140 B. They cannot be in any image inventory (they do not exist at build time) and their .bin extension is in DATA_EXT, so the sweep tried to quarantine them; os.rename fails EBUSY on a bind mount and shutil.move fails EBUSY too, so all of it was CHARGED against the 327,680 B cap and EVERY submission - including the honest reference - failed the byte gate. The pre-existing 'MEASURED 161 MB' EXDEV note describes the same symptom but the wrong cause: no quarantine-directory placement can move a bind mount. FIX: files that are (or live under) a READ-ONLY mount target from /proc/self/mountinfo are ignored, counted under sweep_readonly_mount_files/bytes. This is a CAPABILITY argument, not a cache denylist: those mounts are ro (mode 0444, open r+b -> EROFS) and CapEff=0xa80425fb lacks CAP_SYS_ADMIN, so the solver can neither write them nor create a bind mount. A WRITABLE bind mount (/dev/termination-log, 0666, rw) is deliberately still charged - that one is a real stash channel. sweep_counted_files also raised from 40 to 400 entries + a total count. compute_reward_sha256 re-pinned ffd0d7b232d1... -> e168186fc829...

calibration_pending.strong_baseline_ce: MEASURED 1.454941697688918 (see calibration_measured); a >=3x repeat for an interval is an optional refinement.
calibration_pending.min_plausible_ce: 0.20 confirmed loose: the best measured honest CE is 1.429.
calibration_pending.max_total_bytes: CONFIRMED binding: the strong reference had to quantise to int8 AND drop modules to fit 252,944 B of 327,680 B; a plain bf16 all-projection LoRA would need ~8.8 MB.

seed_policy: Eval-only deterministic metric (median of 3 shifted passes over a fixed hidden corpus, fp32 CE with fp64 accumulation) -> seed policy n/a in the scored path. The strong-baseline CALIBRATION still runs >=5 reference trials to set the anchor with margin.

quality_gate.spec: hard byte budget (dual-measured) + frozen-base digest + logits position-variance floor + real-vs-arbitrary-ids OOD ratio + plausible-CE band + >=300M parameter floor + build hook must return an nn.Module within 90 s. Any failure => reward 0.
quality_gate.note: anti-spoof kit lifted from the family-C quant-golf / sparsity-budget siblings.

held_out.identity: 111 Python source files from deepspeedai/deepspeed + NVIDIA/Megatron-LM, split BY FILE with a fixed sha256-bucket rule, DISJOINT from the visible train (936 files) and the visible val monitor (70 files). Same distribution, never in the visible tree.
held_out.eval: first 196608+ tokens under the frozen Qwen2.5 tokenizer; median of 3 shifted passes; fp32 cross-entropy with an fp64 accumulator; bf16 autocast forward on one H20.
held_out.why_baked_and_fresh: baked root-0700 because the runner cannot argv-inline a 1.1 MB corpus ('argument list too long'); ALSO uploaded fresh under /tests at scoring so the scored copy is never the baked one.

data_loader_checksum_G6.note: the loader IMPLEMENTATION is fully open (the solver may re-tokenize, pack, filter or re-order); the visible corpus BYTES are pinned, and the hidden split is not in the image's model-visible tree at all, so 'train on the graded data' is impossible rather than merely detected.

entry_contract.build: /app/submission/adapter_entry.py :: build_adapted_model(base_model, artifact_path, device) -> nn.Module. base_model is a freshly loaded UNMODIFIED frozen base (transformers Qwen2ForCausalLM, bf16, on device); artifact_path is /app/submission/adapter.bin as staged. The returned module must expose forward(input_ids) -> position-dependent float logits (B,T,V) (a transformers output with .logits or a bare tensor). Eval-only: the harness never re-runs the solver's training.

editable_area: whole /app/repo (huggingface/peft) + /app/submission + the environment, minus the frozen surface.

calibration_measured.eval_determinism: base_ce = 1.5657425161470404 reproduced IDENTICALLY (17 significant digits) in 4 independent verifier runs -> the metric's noise floor is at the float-repr level; median-of-3-shifted-passes + fp32 CE + fp64 accumulation.

strong_reference.recipe: /opt/strong_baseline/train_adapter.py (int8-quantised LoRA, greedy importance-ordered rank allocation, 93 adapted linears, 249,257 B artifact + 3,687 B entry = 252,944 B of 327,680 B), 1400 steps, lr 3e-4 warmup+cosine, seed 1234

at_700_steps.note: the 700-step version was UNDER-TRAINED -> the anchor uses 1400 steps so the baseline is genuinely strong (invariant 1)

floor_probe.recipe: q_proj-only rank-1 bf16 LoRA, 120 steps, lr 5e-5, 94,416 B

shipped_starter.note: MEASURED on v2: the model-visible floor a solver gets for free is 0.180 - low, positive, and every gate passes.

ceiling_probe.recipe: int4 nibble-packed LoRA (2 params/byte -> 152 adapted linears at the SAME cap), 1400 steps, 254,441 B + 2,621 B = 257,062 B
ceiling_probe.note: ONE lever (sub-8-bit adapter packing). The uncapped ceiling stacks more (shared/seeded bases, norm-and-bias capacity, adaptive rank, a leaner container).

degenerate_constant_logits.note: it cleared the 300M parameter floor, so the ONLY thing that stopped it was the anti-spoof probe

calibration_measured.earned_ordering: negatives 0.0 < shipped starter 0.1803 < strong reference 1.0018 (retrained) < int4 ceiling 1.2327 - MEASURED on NVIDIA H20, on a metric whose noise floor is at the float-repr level
calibration_measured.remaining_refinement: repeat the strong reference >=3x to put an interval on the anchor (training is seeded at 1234, so the anchor is reproducible by construction; the 700 vs 1400 pair already shows the direction).

strong_reference_retrained_from_scratch_.note: the 1.0 anchor reproduces to 0.18% after a full independent retrain -> the anchor is real, not a fitted constant

stash_hardening.sweep: 16 writable mounts incl. tmpfs; ~800 solver-created/modified files detected per run; 96-107 quarantined

caught_by: byte charge of the swept stashes

bounding_20260727.spec: the bench reward spec 性能类 (bounded log form)
bounding_20260727.from: OPEN-ENDED, UN-CAPPED: reward = gain_ratio itself (1.0 = matched the strong reference, >1 = beat it, no cap) - which put the MEASURED strong-reference retrain at 1.0018 and the MEASURED int4 ceiling at 1.2327, both OUTSIDE reward.md's [0,1] range
bounding_20260727.to: BOUNDED LOG: reward = min(1.0, ln(gain_ratio/ref_speedup)/ln(ref_speedup)) if gain_ratio > ref_speedup else 0.0, ref_speedup frozen at the measured in-budget ceiling 1.2326578617539896
bounding_20260727.why_the_log_formula_was_KEPT_here_but_NO: reward.md's 性能类 form carries an authoring-legality floor of ref_speedup >= 1.15. This task's MEASURED in-budget ceiling is 1.2327 (int4 nibble-packed LoRA: 152 adapted linears at the same 327,680-byte cap vs the strong reference's 93), which clears 1.15 by 7.2%, and the eval is deterministic to the float-repr level (base_ce reproduced to 17 significant digits in 4 independent runs), so the formula is well-conditioned here. The sibling e2e-c1-quant-golf (ceiling 1.019, absolute FP ceiling 1.1073) and e2e-subquad-lm-golf (ceiling 1.0643) CANNOT reach 1.15 and were reclassified to 实现类 binary instead. Same rule, different measurements.
bounding_20260727.metric_class_caveat: reward.md's 性能类 formula is defined on a WALL-CLOCK speedup measured by ABBA pairing. This task times NOTHING that enters the score: the quantity fed to ln() is a QUALITY ratio (an adaptation-gain fraction on a hidden held-out split at a fixed adapter-byte budget). The result JSON keeps the schema-mandated `speedup` key for compatibility and ADDS metric_kind='quality_ratio_NOT_time_speedup', metric_name='adaptation_gain_ratio', metric_direction='higher_is_better' and timing_measured=false so no downstream reader can mistake it for a latency ratio. cv = 0.0 is a REAL zero (deterministic eval-only metric), not a placeholder.

gradient_under_the_new_formula.note: gate 5 (speedup <= 1) means the shipped starter and the floor probe now score EXACTLY 0.0 where the old formula gave 0.1803 / 0.00736, and the strong reference scores 0.0043 where the old formula gave 1.0018 (out of range).

bounding_20260727.what_stayed_untouched: every hard gate is byte-identical in behaviour: the dual-measured per-file + total adapter byte caps, the whole-filesystem stash sweep (fail-closed without the inventory), the load-hook side-channel scan, the frozen-base sha256 gate, the >=300M parameter floor, the logits position-variance floor, the real-vs-arbitrary-ids OOD ratio, the plausible-CE band, the 90 s build-hook cap, and the -I + PYTHONSAFEPATH shadow-proofing. No test removed, no tolerance loosened.

ref_speedup.status: CALIBRATED and ACTIVE - read as a FROZEN CONSTANT by the scorer, which never runs the oracle.
ref_speedup.definition: the MEASURED adaptation-gain ratio of the in-budget CEILING recipe (solution/ceiling/train_adapter.py, int4 nibble-packed LoRA at 1400 steps)
ref_speedup.legality: 1.2327 >= reward.md's 1.15 authoring floor (margin +7.2%); ln(ref) = 0.20917270129185545; reward 0.5 lands exactly on the demonstrated ceiling and saturates at gain_ratio 1.51945
ref_speedup.conditioning: the scored eval is deterministic: base_ce = 1.5657425161470404 reproduced to 17 significant digits in 4 independent verifier runs (median of 3 shifted passes, fp32 CE with an fp64 accumulator). A full independent RETRAIN of the strong reference reproduced its gain ratio to 0.18% (1.0 -> 1.0017936616629617), which moves the reward by 0.0043 - so the constant is not fitted to a single lucky run.
ref_speedup.provenance: NVIDIA H20 2026-07-26, image :v1@sha256:e20cb058 (ceiling + anchor) and :v2@sha256:2a3ad287 (independent strong-reference retrain). Measured ceiling CE = 1.4291630161858593 with entry_sha256 bbf91ebf... == the archived solution/ceiling/adapter_entry.py; the strong-baseline retrain was a separate confirmation run.
ref_speedup.re_measurement_note: the ceiling recipe as ARCHIVED had STEPS = 700 while the measurement used 1400 (the calibration driver string-substituted it); the archived file was corrected to 1400 on 2026-07-27 so the constant is reproducible from the archive as-is.
ref_speedup.hardware_and_data_caveat: 此 ref_speedup=1.2326578617539896 与 thresholds.strong_baseline_ce=1.454941697688918 都是在 H20 上、且在**原始** /data/datasets/a8_syscode 语料上训练后标定的。原始语料字节未随题包发布且不可复原(manifest 只记了摘要),开源版 Dockerfile 用固定 ref 的公开仓库(DeepSpeed/Megatron-LM/gpt-neox/torchtitan)确定性重建等价语料,并在 build 时比对摘要、不一致则显著告警。thresholds.expected_base_ce=1.5657425161470404 每次现场重测(漂移容差 0.05),只依赖摘要固定的冻结底座权重 + tests/holdout_corpus.txt,不受语料影响。oracle/强基线实现:task/solution/ceiling/ 与 task/solution/strong_baseline/(reviewer-only,不进镜像)。

recalibrate_howto.note: 本题 verifier 支持模式分派(VERIFIER_MODE),参考实现通过 STRONG_BASELINE_DIR/挂载点提供
recalibrate_howto.step1_strong_baseline: docker run --rm --gpus all --shm-size=8g -v "$PWD/tests:/tests:ro" -v "$PWD/solution/strong_baseline:/opt/strong_baseline:ro" -e VERIFIER_MODE=strong_baseline -e STRONG_BASELINE_DIR=/opt/strong_baseline fai/e2e-a8-peft-adapter-byte-golf:oss bash /tests/test.sh
recalibrate_howto.step2_ceiling: docker run --rm --gpus all --shm-size=8g -v "$PWD/tests:/tests:ro" -v "$PWD/solution/ceiling:/opt/ceiling:ro" -e VERIFIER_MODE=ceiling fai/e2e-a8-peft-adapter-byte-golf:oss bash /tests/test.sh
recalibrate_howto.step3: 从 /logs/verifier/benchmark_results.json 读 CE / gain_ratio(建议 >=3 次取中位数)
recalibrate_howto.guard: gain_ratio <= 1 或 ref_speedup 非法 => reward 0(带具名原因)

open_source_notes.inventory: 字节上限的执行依赖 baseline_inventory.tsv.gz(缺失则 compute_reward.py 失败关闭)。题包 tests/ 不含该文件:开源镜像在最后一层生成到 /opt/a8_inventory/,并用 ENV E2E_INVENTORY_PATH 指给 verifier(_frozen(name, env) 优先用 env 路径)。
open_source_notes.base_model: thresholds.base_model_sha256 是硬校验:开源 Dockerfile 从公开 HF 仓库 Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct 下载后在 build 期即断言该摘要,错版本在 build 期就失败,而不是判分时变成一个莫名的 0。
open_source_notes.dropped_from_image: 原镜像把 /tests、/opt/stash_oracle、/opt/strong_baseline、/opt/negative 以 root-0700 烤进镜像 —— 容器以 uid 0 运行时这等于没有防护。开源版一律不烤,改为判分/重标定时挂载。
